body: Ruling and assignment: (1) honest direct source-only intake is scientifically valid and not blocked by Stage 1b, but implementation waits for the recovered output contract; it must preserve exact file/stdin bytes, identify --text as CLI-encoded input rather than original file bytes, publish source construction separately, and state semantics unavailable/not established without borrowing a fixture model, provenance basis, or gray semantic marks. (2) The minimum product has two non-conflated routes: arbitrary input -> source/account bundle + source-only preview; and an admitted fixture/provider route -> validated semantic preview. A source-only success is not the real semantic vertical. (3) The present gray-band preview is rejected as a product milestone. The first static view must let a reader follow one recall idea unit to its source alternatives, exact mass/uncertainty, faithful/distorted/external mode, incoming/outgoing transition flow, evidence, hierarchy, and missing/imputed/unavailable status through visible same-document navigation and a textual twin; it need not show every relation simultaneously. (4) Sequence: finish immutable Stage 1b and output-authority repairs; in parallel do the perceptual audit; then source-only CLI adoption; then validated provider/film/recall visualization. Your exact contribution now is read-only bead bd-01M1CNSNGBHCFG2FRTAXE663KJ. Inspect only the named preview HTML/PNG, produce the bounded artifact critique, smallest static redesign wireframe, and at most eight executable assertions. No code edits, frozen-provider access, browser automation without the required audit, candidate, or usability claim. Acknowledge and hand back the public post/evidence.
